title: Triple Paralympic Champion Mathieu Bosredon Retires from Paracycling
summary: Mathieu Bosredon, a French paracyclist and triple Paralympic champion, has ended his professional career at age 34, notable for becoming the first French paracyclist to sign a pro contract with Team Cofidis in 2024.
body:

title: Eastern Municipality Develops 73km of Paths to Enhance Universal Access and Quality of Life in Khobar
summary: The Eastern Governorate in Saudi Arabia has developed 73 kilometers of pathways to improve universal accessibility and quality of life in the city of Khobar. These physical infrastructure enhancements aim to ensure that public spaces are navigable and inclusive for people with mobility disabilities.
body:
The Eastern Governorate in Saudi Arabia has developed 73 kilometers of pathways to improve universal accessibility and quality of life in the city of Khobar. These physical infrastructure enhancements aim to ensure that public spaces are navigable and inclusive for people with mobility disabilities.
